categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in digital transformation services focusing on three strategic business areas: big data/artificial intelligence, domestic databases, and satellite internet. Additional segments include IoT products and technology development and services. The business model involves providing products and integrated solutions for digital transformation, including software, hardware, and communication technologies.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include intelligent big data fusion platforms, proprietary large language models (格致大模型), cloud-edge integrated intelligent platforms, and a suite of database products such as GreatDB centralized and distributed databases with proprietary engines (Rapid and TURBO). The company also develops satellite internet technologies covering space, ground, and user segments with full-stack 5G wireless communication core technologies. Production methods emphasize in-house R&D, ecosystem collaboration, and integration of AI, big data, and satellite communication technologies.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are telecom operators, large enterprises, government departments, and state grid companies. The company serves multiple industries including government, energy, telecommunications, finance, transportation, and healthcare. Major markets include digital government, smart cities, smart energy grids, and satellite internet applications.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with strategic hubs in Chengdu (headquarters), Beijing, Shanghai, Guangdong, Shaanxi, and market coverage extending to Yunnan, Guizhou, Guangxi, Hainan, Shanxi, Henan, Hubei, and Jiangsu provinces. It also has subsidiaries and investments in Hong Kong, Cambodia, and Malaysia.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the IT and satellite communication supply chain, focusing on software development, system integration, and provision of end-to-end solutions. It also engages in upstream R&D for core technologies such as database engines and satellite communication payloads.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include deepening integration of AI and big data, advancing domestic database technology for MySQL replacement, and expanding satellite internet capabilities with full-stack 5G wireless communication technologies. R&D focuses on AI model development, data governance, edge computing, digital twins, and satellite communication payloads. The company emphasizes ecosystem collaboration with universities and industry partners and plans to enhance intelligent operation platforms and AI capability sensing platforms.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales (software, hardware), technology development and consulting services, integrated digital transformation solutions, and licensing. Sales channels include direct sales, regional agents, and public bidding. The company also earns from investment income and government subsidies.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company positions itself as a leading domestic digital transformation service provider with strong capabilities in AI, big data, domestic databases, and satellite internet. It holds a leading position in MySQL domestic replacement in the database market and is among the earliest private enterprises in China's satellite internet industry. Competitors include other domestic IT service providers and database vendors, but the company emphasizes its full-stack autonomous technology and ecosystem advantages.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.41 billion, a 16.08% decrease from the previous year, with a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 78.86 million, showing an 83.38% reduction in loss compared to 2023. The company has total assets of about RMB 3.12 billion and equity attributable to shareholders of about RMB 1.84 billion. Despite losses, cash flow from operations improved significantly. The company is undergoing strategic restructuring and focusing on sustainable growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its full-stack autonomous and controllable technology advantages, including proprietary AI large models tailored for vertical industries, high-performance domestic databases with superior query engines, and comprehensive satellite internet solutions covering space, ground, and user segments. It differentiates through deep industry integration, ecosystem collaboration, and a broad portfolio of digital transformation products and solutions that enable clients to leverage data as a strategic asset and accelerate intelligent upgrades.
